decision_conditions:
CAR FREE DEVELOPMENT (COMPLIANCE): All future occupiers of the residential units hereby approved shall not be eligible to obtain an on street residents parking permit except: i) In the case of disabled persons; ii) In the case of units designated in this planning permission as 'non car free'; or iii) In the case of the resident who is an existing holder of a residents parking permit issued by the London Borough of Islington and has held the permit for a period of at least one year.

REASON: To ensure that the development remains car free in accordance with policy T6 of the London Plan 2021, policy T3 of the Islington Local Plan: Strategic and Development Management Policies 2023 and to comply with Schedule 2, Part 20, Class AB.2.(1)(a) of the General Permitted Development Order (2015) as amended.
description: Prior Approval Application under Schedule 2, Part 20 Class AB of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 for an upward extension of existing building by two additional storeys to create 4 new flats [3 x 1 bedroom flats and 1 x 2 bedroom flats] (Amended Scheme)
